description: Demo recordings for the Hemodynamic Concepts App. All held out from Version 5 training.

recordings.title: Simulated: septic shock
recordings.description: Starts normotensive and deteriorates below MAP 65 - demonstrates early deterioration alerts.
recordings.split: held-out synthetic test split (never used in training)

recordings.title: Simulated: vasopressor rescue
recordings.description: Hypotension followed by vasopressor rescue - demonstrates intervention-response tracking.
recordings.split: held-out synthetic test split (never used in training)

recordings.title: Simulated: mixed shock stiff
recordings.description: Mixed shock with stiff vessels treated with vasopressor and fluid - most complex physiology.
recordings.split: held-out synthetic test split (never used in training)

recordings.title: Simulated: fluid challenge
recordings.description: Fluid bolus in a normotensive patient - tests response assessment when the MAP change is small.
recordings.split: held-out synthetic test split (never used in training)

recordings.title: Simulated: hemorrhage resuscitation
recordings.description: Haemorrhage compensated by vasoconstriction, then fluid - tests R/C tracking when MAP is maintained.
recordings.split: held-out synthetic test split (never used in training)

recordings.title: Simulated: stable
recordings.description: Haemodynamically stable throughout - checks the system does not raise false alerts.
recordings.split: held-out synthetic test split (never used in training)

recordings.title: Simulated: low compliance
recordings.description: Reduced arterial compliance with stable MAP - checks compliance (C) tracking.
recordings.split: held-out synthetic test split (never used in training)
